description: This file implements a thread-safe string atomization system with a global shared state, including a custom hash table, slab allocator for strings, and thread-local caches for efficient string deduplication.

classes.name: StringAtomSet
classes.description: Manages a global set of unique string pointers with thread safety and slab allocation.

classes.name: ThreadLocalCache
classes.description: Provides thread-local caching for string lookups to improve performance.

classes.name: Slab
classes.description: Handles memory allocation for strings in fixed-size slabs to optimize string storage.
